description: Defines data structures and constants related to 3GPP RRC (Radio Resource Control) types and procedures, including reconfiguration, security, and measurement configurations within the ocudu::ocucp namespace.

classes.name: rrc_srb_to_add_mod
classes.description: Represents configuration for adding or modifying a Signaling Radio Bearer (SRB) in RRC procedures.

classes.name: rrc_cn_assoc
classes.description: Represents a core network association with optional EPS bearer ID and SDAP configuration.

classes.name: rrc_drb_to_add_mod
classes.description: Represents configuration for adding or modifying a Data Radio Bearer (DRB) in RRC procedures.

classes.name: rrc_security_algorithm_config
classes.description: Holds security algorithms for ciphering and integrity protection.

classes.name: rrc_security_config
classes.description: Contains security configuration including algorithms and key.

classes.name: rrc_radio_bearer_config
classes.description: Configures radio bearers, including lists of SRBs and DRBs, and security settings.

classes.name: rrc_master_key_upd
classes.description: Represents a master key update with indication, chaining count, and NAS container.

classes.name: rrc_recfg_v1530_ies
classes.description: Contains optional information elements for RRC reconfiguration, version 15.30.

classes.name: cu_cp_ue_cho_candidate
classes.description: Represents a candidate for UE handover (Cell Update, C-Plane) with associated configuration.

classes.name: rrc_reconfiguration_procedure_request
classes.description: Encapsulates parameters for requesting an RRC reconfiguration.

classes.name: rrc_ue_capability_transfer_request
classes.description: Placeholder for UE capability transfer request parameters.

classes.name: rrc_ran_area_cfg_t
classes.description: Configuration for RAN area with TAC and area code list.

classes.name: rrc_ran_notification_area_info_t
classes.description: Variant type for RAN notification area info, either cell-based or area-based.

classes.name: rrc_resume_request_response
classes.description: Response structure for RRC resume request, including success flag and optional configurations.
